definitions.DISTINCT_BINDING_DIVERSITY: More than one frozen callable identity is selected and no selected pair shares one callable identity with different bindings.
definitions.INCONCLUSIVE: The sealed selector experiment is unavailable and contains no eligible selection targets or switch activity.
definitions.LINEAGE_SOURCE_INCONSISTENT: At least one selected authority-qualified identity is absent from the combined frozen lineage, has the wrong lottery identity, or source switch metadata cannot be reconciled with selected identities.
definitions.MIXED_DIVERSITY: The selected set contains both a same-callable/different-binding pair and more than one frozen callable identity.
definitions.NO_SWITCH: The available source switch count is zero or all selected qualified identities collapse to one frozen binding identity; raw switch count remains reported separately.
definitions.PARAMETER_SIBLING_DIVERSITY_ONLY: More than one binding is selected, every resolved selection remains in one frozen callable family, and a same-callable/different-binding pair is present.
definitions.actual_distinct_binding_diversity_boolea: actual_distinct_binding_diversity_selected is true exactly when more than one frozen callable identity is selected.
definitions.transition_boundary: Classes describe the set and frequencies of selected identities; they do not assert an unobserved transition order.
